notes: Descriptions are intentionally concise paraphrases suitable for UI/tooltips.
This file separates action economy, prerequisites, resolution, effects, and countermeasures so an engine can reason over them.
A truly complete PF2e corpus should be generated/imported from a licensed structured rules dataset rather than hand-maintained.

ui.short_description: You cannot see; vision-dependent actions and targeting are severely restricted.
An item is damaged enough that it cannot perform its normal function.
Your body is less coordinated, imposing a status penalty on Dexterity-based checks and DCs.
A target is difficult to see; attacks and other checks against it can require a flat check.
You have impaired control and may attack or affect creatures indiscriminately.
Another creature determines your actions within the limits of the controlling effect.
Everything is concealed from you.
You cannot hear normally and have difficulty with auditory effects.
Your connection to death is weakened; it makes dying more dangerous.
Loss of vitality reduces your maximum and current Hit Points.
You are near death and must recover or risk death.
You are carrying too much, reducing movement and imposing a Strength/Dexterity penalty.
Your physical strength is reduced, penalizing Strength-based checks and DCs.
Your attention is strongly drawn to a particular subject.
You are worn down, taking a penalty to AC and saving throws and unable to use exploration activities that require focus.
You are less able to defend yourself, taking a circumstance penalty to AC.
You must spend your actions trying to escape the source of fear or compulsion.
An NPC has a positive attitude toward you.
Your movement is restricted; you cannot use actions with the manipulate trait unless they meet the relevant restriction.
An NPC has a strongly positive attitude and is inclined to assist you.
A creature knows your approximate location but cannot see you directly.
An NPC has a negative attitude and may actively oppose you.
You cannot use actions with the move trait.
An NPC has no strong positive or negative attitude toward you.
You cannot be seen normally; creatures generally need other senses or special effects to locate you.
A creature is plainly visible to you.
Your body is immobilized and you cannot act normally.
You take recurring damage at the specified interval until the persistent damage is removed or ends.
You have been turned to stone and are unable to act normally.
You are on the ground; movement is restricted and you are easier to attack.
You gain one additional action each turn, limited by the effect granting it.
You are tightly held, preventing normal movement and imposing stronger restrictions than grabbed.
Nausea imposes penalties and makes it harder to continue acting until you retch or recover.
You lose actions from your turn according to the condition's value.
You lose actions and usually cannot use reactions while stunned.
Mental impairment penalizes Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma checks and makes spellcasting unreliable.
You are unable to act normally and are typically off-guard.
A creature does not know your location.
An NPC has a negative attitude toward you but is not necessarily actively hostile.
A creature is completely unaware that you are present.
You have been brought back from dying and are at increased risk if you fall dying again.

action.trigger: ally is about to attempt the supported check

ui.short_description: Help an ally with a check or attack when its trigger occurs.

requirements: you are affected by a relevant restraining effect

degree_of_success.critical_success: free; remove relevant conditions; may Step 5 feet
degree_of_success.critical_failure: remain affected; cannot retry until next turn

ui.short_description: Attempt to free yourself from a grab, immobilization, restraint, or similar impediment.
Manipulate an object or nearby terrain: draw, stow, open, pick up, swap, or similar tasks.
Make a short jump, normally up to 10 feet horizontally or 3 feet vertically.

requirements: chosen action is legal to use

ui.short_description: Prepare one action to use as a reaction when a chosen trigger occurs.
Let go of an object or remove a hand from something you hold.

degree_of_success.critical_success: observe hidden/undetected target or locate object
degree_of_success.success: improve detection state or locate object

ui.short_description: Search a defined area for creatures, objects, hazards, or other hidden things.
Move up to your Speed.
Move 5 feet without triggering reactions that respond to movement.
Make a melee or ranged attack with a weapon or unarmed attack.
Get up from prone.
Drop to the ground voluntarily.
Move a short distance while prone.
Use available cover or terrain to improve your defenses against attacks.
Raise a wielded shield to gain its defensive benefit until your next turn.
Choose to take your turn later in the initiative order.
Indicate a creature or feature to help allies detect and understand what you noticed.
Look away to reduce the impact of visual effects.

action.trigger: you fall past a ledge or handhold

ui.short_description: Catch a ledge or handhold while falling past it.

requirements: an applicable fall-arrest ability or circumstance

ui.short_description: Use an available reaction or ability to reduce or prevent falling consequences.

requirements: surface is narrow, uneven, or unstable

ui.short_description: Move carefully across a narrow or unstable surface.
Move through an enemy's space using Acrobatics.
Move upward or across a climbable surface.
Use brute force to open a stuck, locked, or barred object.
Attempt to grab a creature.
Jump upward using Athletics to reach an elevated position.
Jump a long horizontal distance.
Force a creature to move a short distance.
Push a creature away from you.
Move through water.
Knock a creature prone.
Attempt to make a held item easier for its wielder to lose.
Distract creatures so you can become harder to notice.
Mislead a foe, making your next attack against it more effective.
Give a false statement intended to make another creature believe it.
Present yourself as another creature or role.
Question people to learn useful information about a topic.
Improve another creature's attitude through social interaction.
Ask a creature for cooperation.
Use threats to force a creature toward compliance.
Attempt to frighten a creature.
Recall relevant knowledge about a creature, object, location, or subject.
Conceal yourself from creatures that can see you.

requirements: you are hidden or have suitable concealment

ui.short_description: Move while attempting to remain hidden or undetected.
Hide a small object on your person.
Use an artistic performance to entertain or otherwise influence an audience.
Determine cardinal direction or orientation.
Find enough food, water, and shelter to survive.
Follow the trail of creatures or objects.
Make your trail harder to follow.
Conceal a small object in your hand without obvious notice.
Take an unattended or poorly guarded object without being noticed.
Use thieves' tools to open a lock.
Use tools and skill to disable a trap or other mechanism.
Restore a damaged item so it can function normally.
Create an item using Crafting and appropriate formulas/materials.
Perform skilled work to earn money during downtime.
Determine the nature and properties of a magical effect or item.
Add a spell to your repertoire or spellbook using the appropriate magical tradition.
Understand a difficult, coded, archaic, or magical text.
Treat a living creature's injuries with Medicine.
Treat a creature suffering from poison.
Treat a creature suffering from disease.
Stabilize a dying creature or reduce certain immediate medical dangers.

requirements: target is an animal and can understand the command

ui.short_description: Issue a command to an animal companion or other animal.
